bio: Lando Norris may not be named after Star Wars rebel Lando Calrissian – his Mum just liked the moniker – but the 2025 World Champion has flair and fighting spirit in bountiful supply. McLaren had the British teenager on their books for two years before fast-tracking him into Formula 1 in 2019. A firecracker in his junior career, with a penchant for pole positions and wheel-to-wheel tussles, Norris delivered immediately.
